senses.en: to give reasons to support or oppose an idea
senses.pattern: argue that… / argue for / argue against
senses.example: Some scientists [[argue]] that sleeping less than six hours a night harms our memory.
senses.example_zh: 有些科學家主張，每晚睡不到六小時會損害我們的記憶力。

gsat.sentence: You might [[argue]] that if working out doesn’t give you pain, it isn’t working.
In making a case for or against zoos, both sides [[argue]] that they’re saving animals.

senses.en: (of a person) free to meet or talk to someone
senses.pattern: be available for a meeting / be available to help / be available on Friday
senses.example: Dr. Lin is [[available]] on Friday afternoon if you would like to discuss your test results.
senses.example_zh: 如果你想討論檢驗結果，林醫師星期五下午有空。

gsat.sentence: The bank tries its best to attract more customers. Its staff members are always [[available]] to provide prompt service.

senses.en: the hard outer covering of a tree
senses.pattern: tree bark / rough bark / strip the bark / a piece of bark
senses.example: In winter, hungry deer strip the [[bark]] from young trees when there is little grass to eat.
senses.example_zh: 冬天沒什麼草可吃時，飢餓的鹿會啃掉幼樹的樹皮。

senses.en: to shout an order in a loud, sharp voice
senses.pattern: bark orders / bark commands / bark instructions at sb
senses.example: The coach [[barked]] instructions at the players from the sideline throughout the second half.
senses.example_zh: 整個下半場，教練都在場邊對球員厲聲喊出指示。

gsat.sentence: Nutritional products that can be collected from trees include fruits, nuts, seeds, leaves, and [[bark]].
It is covered with a beautiful soft, spongy [[bark]].

senses.en: a living creature, especially a person
senses.pattern: a human being / living beings / intelligent beings / beings from outer space
senses.example: Scientists still wonder whether intelligent [[beings]] exist on planets far beyond our solar system.
senses.example_zh: 科學家仍想知道，在遠離太陽系的行星上是否存在有智慧的生物。

senses.en: the state of existing
senses.pattern: come into being / bring sth into being
senses.example: Nobody knows exactly when the village's famous lantern festival first came into [[being]].
senses.example_zh: 沒有人確切知道這個村莊著名的燈籠節最初是何時誕生的。
senses.note: 此義不可數；come into being＝形成

gsat.sentence: Many people believe that [[beings]] from outer space have visited us for centuries.
Roy Sullivan, a park ranger in the United States, was struck by lightning more recorded times than any other human [[being]].

senses.en: outside the limits, reach, or understanding of
senses.pattern: beyond repair / beyond belief / beyond one's control / beyond me
senses.example: Why anyone would pay that much for a pair of sneakers is completely [[beyond]] me.
senses.example_zh: 為什麼有人願意花那麼多錢買一雙球鞋，完全超出我的理解。

senses.en: apart from; other than
senses.pattern: nothing beyond / know little beyond / beyond that
senses.example: The witness could tell the police nothing [[beyond]] the color of the car that sped away.
senses.example_zh: 除了那輛疾駛而去的車子的顏色之外，目擊者無法告訴警方任何事。
senses.note: 多用於否定句或疑問句

gsat.sentence: This is because many breakthroughs come up when people venture [[beyond]] their usual routines or areas of expertise.
“The blessing that Morgan has brought is [[beyond]] anything that I ever could have imagined and could explain.”

senses.en: a local office or shop of a large organization
senses.pattern: a bank branch / open a new branch / the local branch
senses.example: The bookstore chain plans to open a new [[branch]] near our school next spring.
senses.example_zh: 這家連鎖書店計劃明年春天在我們學校附近開一家新分店。

senses.en: a division of a larger subject or area of knowledge
senses.pattern: a branch of science / a branch of medicine / a branch of mathematics
senses.example: Geometry is the [[branch]] of mathematics that deals with shapes, lines, and angles.
senses.example_zh: 幾何學是數學的一個分支，研究的是形狀、線條與角度。

gsat.sentence: There are three [[branches]] of medicine.

senses.en: to move forward without using power
senses.pattern: coast downhill / coast along / coast to a stop
senses.example: We stopped pedaling and let our bikes [[coast]] down the long hill toward the lake.
senses.example_zh: 我們停止踩踏，讓腳踏車順著長長的下坡朝湖邊滑行。

senses.en: to succeed without making much effort
senses.pattern: coast to victory / coast through the exam / coast into the final
senses.example: The defending champions [[coasted]] to victory, scoring five goals without ever looking tired.
senses.example_zh: 衛冕隊輕鬆取得勝利，攻進五球卻始終不見疲態。

senses.en: to be about or to involve someone or something
senses.pattern: concern sb / as far as … is concerned / to whom it may concern
senses.example: The new rule [[concerns]] only students who ride motorcycles to school, not those who take the bus.
senses.example_zh: 這項新規定只與騎機車上學的學生有關，與搭公車的學生無關。
senses.note: as far as … is concerned＝就…而言

senses.en: a business or company
senses.pattern: a family concern / a business concern / a going concern
senses.example: What began as a small family [[concern]] selling noodles now has forty restaurants across the country.
senses.example_zh: 當初只是賣麵的小型家族企業，如今在全國已有四十家餐廳。

gsat.sentence: However, if we travel west we will be in advance of ourselves as far as our internal clock is [[concerned]], and problems may arise.
They often [[concern]] very strong or clever people who come from humble backgrounds.

senses.en: to formally arrange and agree on a treaty or deal
senses.pattern: conclude a treaty / conclude an agreement / conclude a deal / conclude a contract
senses.example: After months of talks, the two countries finally [[concluded]] a trade agreement last week.
senses.example_zh: 經過數月談判，兩國終於在上週締結貿易協定。
senses.note: 不是「結束協議」，而是「談成、簽訂」

senses.en: money a court orders paid for harm caused
senses.pattern: pay damages / claim damages / be awarded damages / sue for damages
senses.example: The singer sued the magazine for [[damages]] after it printed false stories about her family.
senses.example_zh: 該雜誌刊登有關她家人的不實報導後，這名歌手提告，要求對方支付損害賠償金。

senses.en: to begin to have an illness or problem
senses.pattern: develop cancer / develop a fever / develop an allergy to
senses.example: People who breathe polluted air for years are more likely to [[develop]] lung disease.
senses.example_zh: 長年呼吸受污染空氣的人，比較容易罹患肺部疾病。

senses.en: to make photographs from film using chemicals
senses.pattern: develop film / develop photos / have the pictures developed
senses.example: Before digital cameras, people had to wait days for a shop to [[develop]] their film.
senses.example_zh: 在數位相機問世前，人們得等上好幾天讓店家沖洗底片。

gsat.sentence: This suggests that napping may significantly delay age-related brain shrinkage, and thus lower the possibility of [[developing]] dementia.
Children under 14 who watch horror movies have a greater chance of [[developing]] anxiety later in adulthood.

senses.en: to decide that something is not worth considering
senses.pattern: dismiss an idea / dismiss sth as nonsense / dismiss a suggestion
senses.example: My brother [[dismissed]] my suggestion with a wave of his hand and went on playing his game.
senses.example_zh: 哥哥揮了揮手，對我的建議不予理會，繼續玩他的遊戲。

senses.en: (of a judge) to officially end a court case
senses.pattern: dismiss a case / dismiss a charge / dismiss an appeal
senses.example: The judge [[dismissed]] the case because there was not enough evidence against the driver.
senses.example_zh: 由於對駕駛不利的證據不足，法官駁回了這起案件。

senses.en: an actor with a small non-speaking part in a film
senses.pattern: work as an extra / hire extras / a film extra
senses.example: Hundreds of local residents were hired as [[extras]] for the crowd scenes in the historical film.
senses.example_zh: 數百名當地居民受雇擔任臨時演員，參與這部歷史片中的群眾場面。

senses.en: something added that you must pay more for
senses.pattern: optional extras / pay for extras / no hidden extras
senses.example: The basic price of the tour is low, but meals and museum tickets are [[extras]].
senses.example_zh: 這個行程的基本價格很低，但餐費和博物館門票都是額外收費的項目。

senses.en: a large public event with goods or displays
senses.pattern: a book fair / a job fair / a science fair / a trade fair
senses.example: Dozens of local farmers will sell fresh fruit and honey at the county [[fair]] this weekend.
senses.example_zh: 本週末將有數十位當地農民在縣內的市集販售新鮮水果和蜂蜜。

senses.en: (of skin or hair) pale or light in color
senses.pattern: fair skin / fair hair / a fair complexion
senses.example: Because of her [[fair]] skin, Emma always wears a hat and sunscreen at the beach.
senses.example_zh: 由於皮膚白皙，艾瑪在海邊總是戴帽子並擦防曬乳。

senses.en: quite large in amount, size, or number
senses.pattern: a fair amount of / a fair number of / a fair distance
senses.example: It takes a [[fair]] amount of patience to teach a puppy where to sleep.
senses.example_zh: 教小狗該在哪裡睡覺，需要相當多的耐心。

gsat.sentence: At the Book [[Fair]], exhibitors from 21 countries will display textbooks, novels, and comic books.
Two years later, it was awarded first prize again at Houston’s first annual Invention [[Fair]].

senses.en: a state of great excitement about something
senses.pattern: gold fever / World Cup fever / baseball fever / at fever pitch
senses.example: Soccer [[fever]] swept the whole country when the national team reached the final for the first time.
senses.example_zh: 國家隊首度打進決賽時，足球熱潮席捲全國。
senses.note: 常接在名詞之後，如 gold fever

gsat.sentence: Over 100,000 people with “gold [[fever]]” made this trip hoping to become millionaires.
“gold [[fever]]” was not worth the lives of many people

senses.en: to deal with questions or comments
senses.pattern: field questions / field calls / field complaints
senses.example: After the speech, the scientist spent an hour [[fielding]] questions from curious students.
senses.example_zh: 演講結束後，那位科學家花了一小時應對好奇學生的提問。

senses.en: real conditions outside a laboratory or office
senses.pattern: in the field / field research / a field study
senses.example: The biologist spends six months a year in the [[field]], recording the behavior of wild elephants.
senses.example_zh: 這位生物學家每年有六個月在野外實地記錄野生大象的行為。
senses.note: field trip 實地考察、校外教學

senses.en: a set of rooms to live in; an apartment
senses.pattern: rent a flat / share a flat / a two-bedroom flat / a block of flats
senses.example: While studying in London, she shared a small [[flat]] with two other exchange students.
senses.example_zh: 在倫敦念書期間，她和另外兩位交換學生合住一間小公寓。

senses.en: (of a tire) without enough air; (of a drink) not fizzy
senses.pattern: a flat tire / go flat / flat soda
senses.example: We were late for the picnic because our car got a [[flat]] tire on the highway.
senses.example_zh: 我們野餐遲到了，因為我們的車在公路上有個輪胎洩了氣。

senses.en: (of a fee or rate) fixed and not changing
senses.pattern: a flat fee / a flat rate / a flat fare
senses.example: The museum charges a [[flat]] fee of five dollars, no matter how long visitors stay.
senses.example_zh: 這間博物館收取五美元的固定費用，不論遊客停留多久。

senses.en: an army officer of very high rank
senses.pattern: a four-star general / a retired general / the general's orders
senses.example: The [[general]] ordered his troops to cross the river before sunrise.
senses.example_zh: 將軍命令他的部隊在日出前渡河。

senses.en: highest in rank; having overall responsibility
senses.pattern: general manager / secretary-general / attorney general
senses.example: As [[general]] manager, she is responsible for every department of the hotel.
senses.example_zh: 身為總經理，她要為飯店的每個部門負責。

gsat.sentence: Swiss [[generals]] decided to issue each soldier a standard knife to serve both as a screwdriver and a can opener.

senses.en: a sudden large increase in prices or amounts
senses.pattern: a price hike / a tax hike / a hike in fares / a rate hike
senses.example: Drivers rushed to fill their tanks the night before the fuel price [[hike]] took effect.
senses.example_zh: 油價大幅上漲生效的前一晚，駕駛人紛紛趕去把油加滿。

senses.en: to raise prices, taxes, or rates suddenly
senses.pattern: hike prices / hike taxes / hike interest rates / hike fees
senses.example: The airline [[hiked]] its ticket prices right before the holidays, angering many travelers.
senses.example_zh: 這家航空公司在假期前夕調漲票價，激怒了許多旅客。

senses.en: a scientific rule describing how something always works
senses.pattern: the law of gravity / the laws of nature / the laws of physics / the law of supply and demand
senses.example: According to the [[law]] of gravity, anything you throw into the air must eventually come down.
senses.example_zh: 根據萬有引力定律，任何拋向空中的東西最後都一定會落下。

senses.en: to put down a foundation, cable, or carpet
senses.pattern: lay the foundation for / lay a cable / lay a carpet / lay the groundwork
senses.example: Reading widely in childhood [[lays]] a solid foundation for clear writing later in life.
senses.example_zh: 童年時期廣泛閱讀，能為日後清晰的寫作能力奠定扎實的基礎。
senses.note: lay 也是 lie（躺）的過去式

senses.en: not trained in a particular subject or profession
senses.pattern: a lay person / a lay audience / the lay public / lay readers
senses.example: The doctor explained the surgery in simple words that any [[lay]] person could easily understand.
senses.example_zh: 醫師用淺顯的話解釋這項手術，任何外行的人都能輕易聽懂。

gsat.sentence: Construction began when the first cornerstone was [[laid]] in October of 1792.

senses.en: to be as good as someone or something
senses.pattern: cannot match / match sb for sth / no one can match her / match the quality of
senses.example: No other bakery in town can [[match]] this shop for the freshness of its bread.
senses.example_zh: 論麵包的新鮮度，鎮上沒有別家麵包店比得上這家店。

senses.en: a person equal to another in strength or skill
senses.pattern: be no match for / meet one's match / be more than a match for
senses.example: The young chess player was no [[match]] for the champion and lost in twenty moves.
senses.example_zh: 那位年輕棋手不是冠軍的對手，二十步就輸了。

gsat.sentence: However, they cannot [[match]] the personal attention coming from the distinctive tap of a pea shooter.

senses.en: a way of doing or achieving something
senses.pattern: a means of transportation / by means of / a means to an end
senses.example: For people living on the small island, the ferry is the only [[means]] of reaching the mainland.
senses.example_zh: 對住在這座小島上的人來說，渡輪是前往本島的唯一方法。

senses.en: the money or income that a person has
senses.pattern: live within one's means / beyond one's means / a person of means
senses.example: Hiring a private tutor was beyond the family's [[means]], so Kelly studied with free online videos instead.
senses.example_zh: 請家教超出這家人的財力，所以凱莉改看免費的線上影片自學。

gsat.sentence: Keep in mind that even short periods of low-impact exercise serve as a powerful [[means]] to improve your health.
However, drinking tea in social settings outside the workplace was beyond the [[means]] of the majority of British people.

senses.en: only just achieved or avoided
senses.pattern: a narrow escape / a narrow victory / a narrow defeat / by a narrow margin
senses.example: Our team won a [[narrow]] victory, scoring the final point in the last second.
senses.example_zh: 我們隊在最後一秒拿下最後一分，驚險獲勝。
senses.note: 副詞 narrowly 指「勉強地、差一點」

senses.en: to make or become smaller or more limited
senses.pattern: narrow the gap / narrow down the choices / narrow the search
senses.example: The government hopes the new policy will [[narrow]] the gap between rich and poor.
senses.example_zh: 政府希望新政策能縮小貧富差距。

senses.en: to perform surgery on a patient
senses.pattern: operate on a patient / operate on sb's knee / operate immediately
senses.example: Surgeons [[operated]] on the injured climber for six hours to repair his broken leg.
senses.example_zh: 外科醫師為受傷的登山客動手術長達六小時，修復他骨折的腿。
senses.note: 接 on；名詞 operation 手術

senses.en: (of a business or system) to work or run
senses.pattern: operate in Asia / operate at a loss / operate around the clock
senses.example: The airline [[operates]] in more than thirty countries and carries millions of passengers each year.
senses.example_zh: 這家航空公司在三十多個國家營運，每年載運數百萬名乘客。

gsat.sentence: Intersections will [[operate]] in a way that cars automatically adjust their speed to cross through, while maintaining safe distances from other vehicles.
It’s an admirable project, and it is worth finding out if a similar one [[operates]] in your hometown.

senses.en: to make something as good as possible
senses.pattern: perfect a skill / perfect a technique / perfect one's English
senses.example: The young pianist spent the whole summer [[perfecting]] a difficult piece for the competition.
senses.example_zh: 那位年輕鋼琴家花了整個夏天，為比賽把一首高難度的曲子練到完美。
senses.note: 動詞讀作 /pɚˈfɛkt/，重音在第二音節

senses.en: complete; total
senses.pattern: a perfect stranger / perfect nonsense / with perfect seriousness
senses.example: A [[perfect]] stranger returned my lost wallet without taking a single dollar from it.
senses.example_zh: 一位完全陌生的人把我遺失的錢包還給我，裡面一塊錢也沒少。

gsat.sentence: Understanding how to [[perfect]] your nap is vital for reaping its benefits.
Many folk tales are also tall tales—stories of unbelievable events told with [[perfect]] seriousness.

senses.en: a famous person, especially in entertainment or sport
senses.pattern: a TV personality / a sports personality / a radio personality
senses.example: A well-known television [[personality]] was invited to host the school's charity concert.
senses.example_zh: 一位大家熟悉的電視名人受邀主持學校的慈善音樂會。

senses.en: higher, lower, or better than ever before
senses.pattern: a record number of / a record high / a record low / in record time
senses.example: Farmers in the region enjoyed a [[record]] harvest this year thanks to plenty of rain in spring.
senses.example_zh: 多虧春季雨水充足，這個地區的農民今年迎來創紀錄的大豐收。

senses.en: the known facts about someone's past behavior
senses.pattern: a criminal record / a clean record / a track record / an academic record
senses.example: Because he had no criminal [[record]], the judge gave the young man a second chance.
senses.example_zh: 由於這名年輕人沒有前科，法官給了他一次改過的機會。

gsat.sentence: As a [[record]] number of fans showed up for the baseball final, the highways around the stadium were choked with traffic all day.

senses.en: waste material that has been thrown away
senses.pattern: household refuse / refuse collection / a refuse dump
senses.example: Trucks carry the town's [[refuse]] to a plant where it is burned to produce electricity.
senses.example_zh: 卡車把鎮上的垃圾運到一座工廠，在那裡焚燒發電。

senses.en: to close something tightly or block an entrance
senses.pattern: seal an envelope / seal off the area / a sealed container
senses.example: Put the leftover cookies in a jar and [[seal]] it tightly to keep them crispy.
senses.example_zh: 把吃剩的餅乾放進罐子裡並密封好，以保持酥脆。

senses.en: an official stamp, or something that keeps a container closed
senses.pattern: an official seal / a wax seal / break the seal
senses.example: The letter carried the royal [[seal]], so the guards let the messenger enter the palace at once.
senses.example_zh: 那封信上蓋有皇家印章，所以衛兵立刻讓信差進入王宮。

senses.en: to make an agreement or result certain
senses.pattern: seal a deal / seal a victory / seal sb's fate
senses.example: The two companies [[sealed]] the deal with a handshake after six months of talks.
senses.example_zh: 經過六個月的談判，兩家公司握手敲定了這筆交易。

gsat.sentence: Some waste from nuclear power plants is buried in [[sealed]] containers.
It is said that in ancient times a man would place a drop of blood between his wife’s eyes to [[seal]] their marriage.

senses.en: a small piece of paper
senses.pattern: a slip of paper / a permission slip / a pay slip / a sales slip
senses.example: Each student wrote a wish on a [[slip]] of paper and dropped it into the box.
senses.example_zh: 每位學生把願望寫在一張紙條上，然後投進箱子裡。

senses.en: to go somewhere quietly without being noticed
senses.pattern: slip out of the room / slip away / slip into / slip past sb
senses.example: Not wanting to wake the baby, she [[slipped]] quietly out of the room and closed the door.
senses.example_zh: 她不想吵醒寶寶，便悄悄溜出房間並關上門。

senses.en: a small mistake
senses.pattern: a slip of the tongue / make a slip / one small slip
senses.example: One small [[slip]] during the final dance routine cost the team the championship.
senses.example_zh: 最後一段舞蹈中的一個小失誤，讓這支隊伍痛失冠軍。
senses.note: a slip of the tongue＝口誤

senses.en: to make something dirty
senses.pattern: soil your clothes / soiled diapers / soil your hands
senses.example: Wear an apron while painting so that you don't [[soil]] your school uniform.
senses.example_zh: 畫畫時請穿上圍裙，以免弄髒學校制服。

senses.en: a country's land or territory
senses.pattern: on foreign soil / on home soil / on Japanese soil
senses.example: It was the first time the team had ever won a championship on foreign [[soil]].
senses.example_zh: 這是該隊第一次在外國的國土上贏得冠軍。

gsat.sentence: Whenever I set foot on the [[soil]] of Rwanda, a country in east-central Africa, I feel as if I have entered paradise: green hills, red earth, sparkling rivers and mountain lakes.

senses.en: to notice someone or something, often suddenly
senses.pattern: spot a mistake / spot the difference / spot sb in a crowd / be spotted doing
senses.example: A sharp-eyed student [[spotted]] a mistake in the textbook and reported it to the teacher.
senses.example_zh: 一位眼尖的學生發現課本裡有個錯誤，並向老師反映。

senses.en: a difficult situation
senses.pattern: in a tight spot / in a tough spot / put sb on the spot
senses.example: Losing his passport abroad put Kevin in a tight [[spot]], but the embassy quickly helped him.
senses.example_zh: 在國外遺失護照使凱文陷入困境，幸好大使館很快伸出援手。
senses.note: put sb on the spot＝使某人難堪

gsat.sentence: Zoe was just 2 weeks old when she was [[spotted]] wandering in a village market near Kenya’s Tsavo National Park in December 1995.
A month after their release, the whales were [[spotted]].

senses.en: a slight sign that something is true or exists
senses.pattern: there is no suggestion that / any suggestion of cheating / a strong suggestion that
senses.example: The police said there was no [[suggestion]] that the fire had been started on purpose.
senses.example_zh: 警方表示，沒有跡象顯示這場火災是有人蓄意縱火。

senses.en: a very small amount or slight trace of something
senses.pattern: a suggestion of a smile / a suggestion of sadness / a suggestion of garlic
senses.example: There was only a [[suggestion]] of a smile on his face when he heard the good news.
senses.example_zh: 聽到好消息時，他臉上只露出一絲微笑。
senses.note: 常用 a suggestion of＋名詞

senses.en: a language
senses.pattern: mother tongue / native tongue / a foreign tongue
senses.example: The old songs are sung in a [[tongue]] that only a few village elders still understand.
senses.example_zh: 這些古老的歌謠是用一種只有少數村中長者還聽得懂的語言唱的。

gsat.sentence: People who learned a second language later in life used a special part of Broca’s area for their second language—near the one activated for their native [[tongue]].

senses.en: to follow the movement or progress of something
senses.pattern: track a package / track the movements of / track down
senses.example: Researchers attach small radio tags to sea turtles to [[track]] their journeys across the Pacific.
senses.example_zh: 研究人員在海龜身上裝小型無線電標籤，以追蹤牠們橫越太平洋的旅程。

senses.en: marks left on the ground by a person, animal, or vehicle
senses.pattern: animal tracks / tire tracks / keep track of / lose track of
senses.example: The hunters followed the bear's [[tracks]] in the snow until they disappeared at the river.
senses.example_zh: 獵人沿著雪地上熊的足跡前進，直到足跡在河邊消失。

gsat.sentence: We haven’t seen John for a long time. As a matter of fact, we have lost [[track]] of him.
Moreover, each visitor is offered the option to wear a GPS Adventure Band, which allows them to keep [[track]] of each other while in the park.

senses.en: a clever and effective way of doing something
senses.pattern: the trick is to / a trick for remembering / do the trick
senses.example: The [[trick]] to making fluffy pancakes is to avoid stirring the batter too much.
senses.example_zh: 煎出鬆軟鬆餅的訣竅，就是不要過度攪拌麵糊。

senses.en: to make someone believe something false
senses.pattern: trick someone into doing / trick someone out of money / be tricked by
senses.example: The website [[tricked]] thousands of users into giving away their passwords and bank details.
senses.example_zh: 這個網站欺騙了數千名使用者，讓他們交出密碼和銀行資料。

gsat.sentence: Especially when a burger craving hits…a GreenBurger does the [[trick]].
Their brain is therefore [[tricked]] into thinking they are eating more than they really are.

senses.en: a large amount of something good or useful
senses.pattern: a wealth of information / a wealth of experience / a wealth of detail
senses.example: The museum's website offers a [[wealth]] of information about local history and wildlife.
senses.example_zh: 這座博物館的網站提供了大量關於當地歷史與野生動物的資訊。
senses.note: 固定用 a wealth of＋名詞

senses.en: importance, influence, or value
senses.pattern: carry weight / give weight to / add weight to an argument / attach weight to
senses.example: The judges gave equal [[weight]] to creativity and teamwork when choosing the winning project.
senses.example_zh: 評審在選出優勝作品時，把創意和團隊合作看得同等重要。

senses.en: a great worry or responsibility
senses.pattern: a weight off one's mind / the weight of responsibility / a weight on one's shoulders
senses.example: Finally telling her parents the truth was a huge [[weight]] off her mind.
senses.example_zh: 終於向父母說出實情，讓她卸下了心頭的重擔。

senses.en: to send money electronically from one bank to another
senses.pattern: wire money / wire sb $500 / wire funds to an account
senses.example: His parents [[wired]] him some money so that he could pay the hospital bill abroad.
senses.example_zh: 他的父母電匯了一些錢給他，讓他能支付在國外的醫藥費。

senses.en: to connect something to an electrical system
senses.pattern: wire a house / wire a plug / be wired to / be wired for sound
senses.example: The electrician [[wired]] the new classroom so that every desk had its own power outlet.
senses.example_zh: 電工替新教室裝設線路，讓每張書桌都有自己的插座。

quiz.stem: The twin sisters are easy to tell apart because one has dark brown hair like their father, while the other has ______ hair like their mother.
quiz.explain_zh: fair＝（髮色）淺的、金色的。雙胞胎一個像爸爸是深褐色頭髮，另一個像媽媽是淺色頭髮。

quiz.stem: With prices rising every month, many families find it harder to live within their ______ and have to borrow money.
quiz.explain_zh: means＝財力、收入。物價月月上漲，許多家庭難以量入為出，只好借錢。

quiz.stem: Having coached young athletes for over thirty years, Mr. Chen brings a ______ of experience to the school's new basketball program.
quiz.explain_zh: wealth＝大量、豐富。陳教練為新的籃球計畫帶來三十多年的豐富經驗。

quiz.stem: Because Dr. Lee has studied sea turtles for thirty years, her opinions carry a lot of ______ with the officials who make conservation policies.
quiz.explain_zh: weight＝分量、重要性。李博士研究海龜三十年，意見對官員很有分量。

quiz.stem: The final math problem was completely ______ most of the class; even the top student had no idea where to begin.
quiz.explain_zh: beyond＝超出（能力、理解）。最後一題數學連全班第一名都不知從何下手。

quiz.stem: Many commuters complained about the sudden ______ in train fares, which made their daily trips to work nearly twenty percent more expensive.
quiz.explain_zh: hike＝大幅上漲。火車票價突然調漲，通勤族上班的車資貴了近兩成。

quiz.stem: At the press conference after the game, the coach patiently ______ questions from reporters about why the team had lost so badly.
quiz.explain_zh: field＝應對（提問）。教練在賽後記者會上耐心回答記者的提問。

quiz.stem: After the factory was found guilty of polluting the river, the court ordered it to pay two million dollars in ______ to nearby farmers.
quiz.explain_zh: damages＝損害賠償金。法院判工廠賠償附近農民兩百萬元。

quiz.stem: Residents complained that piles of household ______ had been left on the sidewalk for days, attracting rats and giving off a terrible smell.
quiz.explain_zh: refuse＝垃圾。家庭垃圾堆在人行道上好幾天，引來老鼠又發臭。

quiz.stem: Although several engineers had warned that the old bridge was unsafe, the mayor ______ their concerns as exaggerated and kept it open to traffic.
quiz.explain_zh: dismiss＝不予理會。市長認為工程師的擔憂言過其實，不予理會。
